original_test_intent: Verify that every Type 20 Memory Device Handle resolves uniquely to the intended Type 17 device and that the associated device range belongs to the correct Type 19 array mapping before and after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 17/19/20 records, create a unique Type 17 handle map, resolve each Type 20 reference with its full range and parent Type 19 handle, validate inventory/interleave exceptions, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies expected inventory/topology and approves reboot; no physical memory action is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected Type 17 device identities and handles
Expected Type 20-to-Type 17 and parent Type 19 mapping
Parser with unique/orphan/duplicate checks and OS-map context
safety_requirements: Use read-only collection; do not alter DIMMs, firmware, kernel or memory mapping.
Require each Type 20 handle to resolve to exactly one Type 17 structure and preserve its range/parent context.
Never silently repair reserved, dangling, duplicate or ambiguous handles.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on relationship drift or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Build the Type 17 handle map, resolve every Type 20 reference, verify device and parent-range ownership plus approved exceptions, and compare pre/post reboot.
Report orphan, duplicate, ambiguous, wrong-device or drifting relations without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve inventory/topology and disabled/interleave exceptions plus reboot plan.
Resolve semantic ownership conflicts and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove unique Type 17 resolution, record completeness or parent-range ownership.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw Type 17/19/20 data; report every Type 20 handle, unique Type 17 target, full device range, parent Type 19 relation, exception status and pre/post graph diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Memory Device Handle scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no topology change is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve every Type 20 device reference against a uniqueness-checked Type 17 inventory, retain full Type 20 range and Type 19 parent relationship, apply explicit exceptions, and compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 and Type 20 handle plus Type 19 relationship definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target uniqueness, orphan/duplicate detection and complete range/parent ownership.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects numerically plausible but dangling, duplicated or wrong-device references missed by grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved inventory, mapping and exception policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Logical/interleaved mappings need project interpretation but do not justify silently changing references.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve disabled/logical/interleaved devices or multiple Type 20 records, but each Type 20 handle must still resolve uniquely to the documented Type 17 identity.
expected_evidence: Approved Type 17 inventory and Type 19/20 mapping/exception policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/19/20 records and versions
Unique resolution table with each Type 20 range, Type 17 target and Type 19 parent
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot relationship diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Memory Device Handle is a valid Type 20 reference; expected topology is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Handle uniqueness, ownership and persistence checks are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds unique resolution, orphan/duplicate detection and range/parent ownership.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains topology safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing inventory/reboot inputs and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a handle string from passing when it resolves nowhere, resolves twice or attributes a range to the wrong memory device.
independent_technical_reasoning: Reference integrity is a deterministic graph check over read-only tables; owner topology supplies expectations but no manual core action.
